verdict.rationale: Apple's own docs confirm its AI stack (MLX, Core ML, Metal, PyTorch-via-Metal backend) explicitly targets Apple Silicon GPU/Neural Engine, and M4 Pro's unified memory/bandwidth specs are marketed for AI workloads. However, there's no explicit mention of llama.cpp or ONNX Runtime support, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of these frameworks running well on M4 Pro specifically. Missing for 10: llama.cpp/ONNX Runtime documentation or benchmarks, independent developer confirmation of local-AI runtime performance on M4 Pro.
